authorship: Codex gpt-6.1-sol / ultra as assigned; no other model called.
method: One bounded prerequisite evidence batch. Dependent targeted reads stopped after establishing serial-v5 provenance and the current software manifest difference.

operations.actions: Read global, work and platform AGENTS, CURRENT_STATUS, and the exact next-goal contract. The initial filename lookup used rg across work and .codex, broader than the requested target directory listing; it did not read extra source contents.

List specified directory first levels, plus manifest-indicated fpga-src, work-fpga, manifests and boot directories. The first verbose listing output was truncated; the full first-level listing was then saved locally.

Read serial-v3 relocation and acceptance only for historical mapping; serial-v5 acceptance, recovery and build inputs; builder interface, sources lock and config. No additional old profile source or timing traversal.

Compute SHA256, mtime and size of selected BIT, Image, DTB and reports; read original routed report; compare 18 overlay hashes and normalize builder-owned top parameters; inspect historical flash and boot metadata only.

Read the matching composition manifest software blob hashes and mode; extract current Image banner and decompile DTB read-only. No composition BIT selected or audited. One attempted generic composition BIT stat returned FileNotFoundError; the manifest supplied its actual isolated path, which was not further traversed.
Read Git HEAD and tracked status for platform, CVA6, IOMMU and Linux; no untracked scan, make check, or checkout mutation.
Write only the identity exclusive output directory, including original line excerpts and hashes. Verify JSON serialization and internal fact consistency only.

limitations: Per-command timestamps were not recorded at dispatch. Collection close UTC is explicit. No elapsed-time, token or cost savings claimed.
